name: Astera Labs
thesis: Connectivity chips for AI racks; still growing fast. Up 13.7% Nov 9, recovering most of the Nov 5 fall.
risks: High beta, customer concentration, capex slowdown fears

name: Advanced Micro Devices
thesis: Q3 beat (rev $13.38B vs $13.09B est). Up 13.3% Nov 9 on an Oppenheimer upgrade to buy; back above pre-selloff level.
risks: Data-centre spending fears, OpenAI deal hit to net income

name: Broadcom
thesis: Custom AI chips and networking. Up 8.8% Nov 9, recovering the earlier 10% drop.
risks: Hyperscaler capex cuts, custom-chip customer concentration

name: Celestica
thesis: AI server and switch maker for hyperscalers. Up 7.9% Nov 9 after a 21% two-day fall.
risks: Capex slowdown hits orders directly; low margin business
catalyst: Nvidia results and hyperscaler capex commentary, mid Nov

name: SK hynix
thesis: HBM leader; Q3 revenue passed 100T won, over half of 2027-28 capacity reportedly contracted. US line up 5.5% Nov 9; Seoul shares up 6.7% Nov 10.
risks: Memory cycle turn, HBM demand fears, Kospi selling

name: Bloom Energy
thesis: On-site fuel-cell power for data centres. Up 11.9% Nov 9, back near pre-selloff levels.

name: GE Vernova
thesis: Gas turbines and grid gear sold out for years; demand not only data centres. Up 7.1% Nov 9.

name: Vertiv
thesis: Power and cooling for data centres. Up 9.6% Nov 9 after a 25% two-day fall; most exposed to any build slowdown.
catalyst: Any data-centre policy detail from new Congress, Jan 2027

name: Robinhood
thesis: Retail brokerage growth; trading volume tracks risk appetite. Up 3.0% Nov 9; launched UK IPO Access.
risks: Volume drop in a risk-off market, regulation

name: MercadoLibre
thesis: LatAm e-commerce and fintech leader. Up 1.5% Nov 9, lagging the rebound; Brazil politics weighs.
risks: Brazil politics and currency, credit losses
catalyst: Brazil policy signals after election, Nov 2026

name: Cloudflare
thesis: Q3 revenue $782.5M, +39%; guidance raised. Up 9.3% Nov 9 after 9.9% Nov 6. Thesis strengthened.

name: Sea Limited
thesis: Shopee, Garena, Monee in SE Asia. Up 2.9% Nov 9. No change.
catalyst: Q3 results, date not yet announced (last year Nov 11)

name: Keyence
thesis: Factory automation sensors, ~50% operating margin. Up 2.6% Nov 9 and 5.1% Nov 10 in Tokyo; thesis intact.

name: ASML Holding
thesis: Sole EUV supplier; monopoly intact. Up 6.2% Nov 9, above the pre-selloff level.
risks: China export rules, memory capex cuts
catalyst: Q4 orders with results, late Jan 2027

name: Teradyne
thesis: Chip test for AI and HBM plus robotics. Up 12.7% Nov 9 after a 21% two-day fall.
